resources.string: Import attachments from one IMAP mailbox while the app is open. The password is kept in your system keyring, never in the library.
This device has no system keyring to keep the mail password in, so it cannot import email.
Check this account on this device
Each of your devices chooses for itself. Checks run only while No Papers Needed is open; nothing is fetched while it is closed.
A password is saved in your system keyring.
Leave blank to keep the saved password. It is stored in your system keyring, not in the library.
No password for this account is saved on this device. Enter it and save the account.
The mailbox folder to read, usually INBOX.
Only use this when your server cannot do SSL or STARTTLS. Your password would travel unprotected.
At least 5 minutes. The app checks while it is open.
A message is imported when any filter matches. Leave the list empty to import every message that has a supported attachment.
Leave the message as it is
The whole email goes to the mailbox’s trash folder, with its text and any attachments the library cannot take, so it can still be recovered there.
Also save the email as a PDF
Adds a readable PDF with the message headers and text to the library.
